versions.content: SAE J1939 lamp status Description: The composite and DTC-specific lamp status of the following lamps shall be supported: Malfunction Indicator Lamp, Red Stop Lamp, Amber Warning Lamp and Protect Lamp. Rationale: Support of SAE J1939-73 Use Case: Diagnostics in HDV, HDOBD AppliesTo: CP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
